_comment: Shown in the update prompts. Edit before each release. minVersion: apps older than this must update before they continue (use for security fixes); leave it at an old version normally.
notes: EWUdiots Club, redesigned: a club home with your clubs, schedule, tasks and messages
Club chat: channels for members, executives and teams, plus direct messages (live)
Meetings with agendas and minutes, project boards, a resource library, polls and full committee elections
Positions: club admins make members President, Secretary, Treasurer, Executive Member, Merch Manager…
Club merch store: order, pay the club by bKash/Nagad/Rocket or cash, collect with a QR code
Event pages with check-in scanner, recruitment scoring, finance & budgets, club analytics
Sponsors, club collaborations, notification centre, help centre and privacy controls
Club pages now show information from EWU's club site (about, faculty moderators, past news)
